scope: Low-level BLOCK_RECORD BLKREFS group-331 identity planning and transport.

source_context.existing_model: DRW_Block_Record retains insertHandles parsed from an application-defined {BLKREFS} group.
source_context.generic_reference_role: Autodesk classifies DXF group codes 330-339 as soft-pointer handles.
source_context.limits: Autodesk's BLOCK_RECORD field table does not list BLKREFS. Generic group-331 role does not establish that this optional list is required or define its complete membership semantics.

implementation.behavior: For each non-null BLKREFS source INSERT handle, writeBlockRecord preallocates the final entity identity before BLOCK_RECORD emission. A configured reference resolver has precedence; otherwise explicit/derived remaps apply, then a fresh entity identity is allocated. The same identity is reused when the INSERT is written. Zero/NoHandle resolver results and aliased entity identities fail before record publication.
implementation.nulls: A retained zero list entry remains zero; this does not establish whether any producer emits null list entries.
implementation.failure_state: The BLOCK_RECORD record scope rolls back staged identity mappings and pending records on failure. Whole-write handle allocation is reset by the write-attempt lifecycle.

validation.input: Generated in-memory records only; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
controls: resolver precedence over an explicit remap
group-331 output equals the later INSERT group-5 identity
zero resolver result refuses before publishing record bytes

qualification_limits: No physical producer or independent consumer was used.
No source-bound BLKREFS-to-INSERT membership proof, target type/owner/block relation, or complete-list proof is established.
dwg2dxf's dx_iface::writeBlockRecords currently supplies an empty BLKREFS list.
This is identity planning and wire transport evidence only; it does not qualify whole-document preservation, native semantics, or a support claim.
